title: A Clockwork Orange
author: Anthony Burgess
summary: Fifteen-year-old Alex narrates in an invented slang as he leads a gang through nights of violence. After his arrest, the state tries to remake him through an experimental treatment, raising questions about free will.
readIf: you like short, audacious novels that challenge you with language and uncomfortable ideas.
skipIf: you are sensitive to graphic violence, or you struggle with heavy invented dialect.

pairings.reason: Another classic about a state controlling its citizens' minds, though colder and more bureaucratic.
A short classic that studies cruelty in the young and what holds civilisation together.
A different kind of controlled society, where comfort and conditioning replace brutality.
